items.description:
Tools are divided into their respective categories (by default, all tools are in user-mode):
Start of the list:

items.title: 🪟 | Al-khaser
items.description: al-khaser is a PoC "malware" application with good intentions that aims to stress your anti-malware system. It performs a bunch of common malware tricks with the goal of seeing if you stay under the radar.

items.title: 🪟 | Pafish
items.description: testing tool that uses different techniques to detect virtual machines and malware analysis environments in the same way that malware families do.

items.title: 🐧🪟🍏 | VMAware
items.description: Easy-to-use cross-platform C++ VM detection library and tool

items.title: 🪟 | GoDefender
items.description: Anti Virtulization, Anti Debugging, AntiVM, Anti Virtual Machine, Anti Debug, Anti Sandboxie, Anti Sandbox, VM Detect package for Go. Windows ONLY.

items.title: 🪟 | antivmdetection
items.description: Script to create templates to use with VirtualBox to make vm detection harder

items.title: 🪟 | InviZzzible
items.description: InviZzzible is a tool for assessment of your virtual environments in an easy and reliable way. It contains the most recent and up to date detection and evasion techniques as well as fixes for them.

items.title: 💽🪟 | illusion-rs
items.description: Rusty Hypervisor - Windows UEFI Blue Pill Type-1 Hypervisor in Rust (Codename: Illusion)

items.title: 🪟 | VMDE
items.description: Virtual Machines Detection Enhanced, source from VMDE paper, adapted to 2015.

items.title: 🪟 | Hypervision-Detection
items.description: Detects virtual machines and malware analysis environments

items.title: 🐧 | inside-vm
items.description: Detect if code is running inside a virtual machine (x86 and x86-64 only).

items.title: 🪟 | Anti-VM
items.description: C++ Windows-based implementation of several anti-vm techniques used in malware development.

items.title: 🐧 | apate
items.description: Apate performs anti-debugging, anti-VM and anti-sandbox tests, to see if your linux system is able to stay under the radar.

items.title: 🐧🪟 | Metasploit
items.description: Open-source penetration testing framework that includes virtual machine detection modules

items.title: 🐧 | systemd-detect-virt (man page)
items.description: detects execution in a virtualized environment. It identifies the virtualization technology and can distinguish full machine virtualization from container virtualization. exits with a return value of 0 (success) if a virtualization technology is detected, and non-zero (error) otherwise.
